svg.aria-label: Step 3 · Scouting Department. A ParallelAgent runs three scouts at once; a report writer merges their work into one brief.
svg.text: A ParallelAgent runs three scouts at once; a report writer merges their work into one brief.
step 1: the scouts, step 2: the writer
three scouts at the same time, each with its own output_key
LlmAgent · no tools: it only merges
You ask: one prompt starts the whole department
The ParallelAgent starts all three scouts at once
Each scout saves its own key; they never share mid-run
report_writer reads the three keys and merges them
